title: VeriDiQ — AI Truth Verification in 30s
logline: A 30-second explainer showing how VeriDiQ's ai truth verification works.
product_brief: VeriDiQ is an AI-native truth verification and workforce platform: a live team of specialist AI agents verifies claims, investigates evidence, tracks markets, and can optionally attest findings on-chain — all with draft-first, human-approved communication so nothing external ever sends itself.
script:
[Scene 1] In a world of unverified claims,
[Scene 2] VeriDiQ's ai truth verification gives you an answer you can actually check.
[Scene 3] A live team of specialist agents does the work — transparently, in real time.
[Scene 4] VeriDiQ runs statements, transcripts, and media through a multi-agent verification pipeline — claim extraction, fact-checking against live sources, deception/emotion signal scoring, and a final truth score with a documented confidence level.
[Scene 5] Start verifying, for free, at veridiq.ai.
